authors.bio: Rowan de Pomerai leads technology strategy and delivery for the DPP, the media industry’s business network. The DPP is the place where customers and suppliers come together to solve problems and create opportunities. He has an MEng degree in electronic engineering with media technology from the University of York, U.K., and a strong background in media innovation, having started his career in British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) Research & Development. Since then, he has delivered transformative change for some of the U.K. ’s biggest broadcasters and producers. This included architecting and deploying the BBC’s automated quality control (QC) solutions, and leading the production modernization project at ITV Studios, streamlining the production and delivery process. Most recently, he was the director of professional services, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA) at Ooyala. He and his team delivered media workflow, asset management, and online video solutions to leading broadcasters, sports clubs, and enterprises. He joined the DPP in 2018.
